verdict.rationale: Cart/checkout tools carry rich attribution metadata (referring_domain, click_id_tag/value, activity_id_tag/value, utm_* fields) that flow from cart into checkout and presumably into the order, and agents must identify via a signed UCP profile/token, giving Shopify the raw data needed to attribute an order to an originating agent. However, there is no evidence of a merchant-facing report, dashboard, or filter in Shopify admin that lets a merchant view or segment transactions by agent — the only 'reporting' surface described is the Order MCP/webhooks for agents themselves, not merchant analytics. Missing for 10: merchant admin UI/analytics showing agent-attributed order reports, documented filter/segment-by-agent capability, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that attribution data surfaces in merchant reporting.
